name: XTTS-v2 (Coqui) — multi-clip clone
blurb: Conditions on ALL your reference clips at once (the more/longer audio, the steadier the clone), 16 languages. ⚠ Weights are CPML: personal/research use only, NOT for a commercial product.

params.label: Temperature
params.help: Sampling randomness. Lower = consistent, higher = varied takes.

params.label: Repetition penalty
params.help: Raise if it stutters or loops sounds.

params.label: Speaking rate (generation)
params.help: XTTS's own rate control — needs a regenerate. Use the live Speed slider below for instant tweaks.

params.label: Pitch (semitones)
params.help: Shift the voice up/down, keeping timbre (TD-PSOLA).

params.label: Intonation range
params.help: How far the pitch swings around its median: 0 = monotone, 1 = as generated, 1.5+ = extra expressive.

params.label: Speed
params.help: Playback tempo without changing pitch (TD-PSOLA), on top of the generation rate.
